Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Persistent
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 190, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 295
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 9,000 gp (lesser), 32,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day as though using the Persistent Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Persistent Spell; Cost 4,500 gp (lesser), 16,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater)
